The constants module is `components/navigation/overlay-layers.ts`. It exports `OVERLAY_LAYERS`, an object of Tailwind class strings such as `"z-[60]"`.

Six files import it:

- `components/ui/select.tsx:6`, via `@/components/navigation/overlay-layers`
- `components/ui/modal.tsx:19`
- `components/ui/combobox.tsx:25`
- `components/navigation/shared-mobile-drawer.tsx:12`
- `components/navigation/account-menu.tsx:25`
- `test/phase-5a-navigation-shell.test.ts:10`, which probably asserts on the layer values, so check it after you change one

Some components don't import the module and may hard-code z-index values. `components/public/customer-vault-drawer.tsx` is one candidate: the comment on `VAULT_BACKDROP` and `VAULT_DRAWER` says `z-[100]`/`z-[101]` is a "preserved contract". Others are `vending-checkout-modal.tsx`, `pre-payment-safety-modal.tsx` and `mobile-nav-drawer.tsx`. They matched my broader search for "overlay", "z-index" and "layer", but they have no import of this module. Changing a value in the module won't affect them. I haven't checked whether they use literal `z-[...]` classes.

Some Tailwind setups only pick up class names that appear literally in scanned files. These values are literal strings in the module, so they're fine as long as that file is in your Tailwind content paths.

Which layer do you want to change? I can grep for hard-coded copies of that specific value.
